pad_seqs_basic: pad a list of variable length tensors to equal length using pad_seqs
pad_seqs_custom_value: pad sequences with a custom pad_value instead of the default zero
pad_seqs_multiple: pad sequences rounding up the sequence dimension to a specified multiple
pad_seqs_device: pad sequences and move the result to a specific device non blocking
pad_seqs_layout: pad sequences and get the BatchLayout describing sequence lengths and shape
